_about: Every test marked @pytest.mark.flaky must have an entry here, and every entry must point to a real flaky test. Enforced by tests/unit/test_flaky_registry.py. A quarantined test is contained with accountability, never silently retried forever. When review_by passes, the guard test fails until someone fixes the test, removes the marker, or re-reviews and extends the date.

entries.reason: Two separate live calls to a public market data API. The price can move between the buy and sell reads, and the public endpoint rate-limits bursts.
entries.exit_plan: Read buy and sell from one recorded response, or assert on a single spread endpoint, so the comparison is atomic.

entries.reason: The public HAPI FHIR sandbox is eventually consistent. A read right after DELETE can still return the resource for a short window.
entries.exit_plan: Poll the read with AsyncPoller until 410 Gone or timeout, instead of retrying the whole test.

entries.reason: HAPI sandbox search index lags behind writes, so create-then-search fails in CI. The test is also skipped, which makes the retries unreachable.
entries.exit_plan: Replace skip plus retries with AsyncPoller on the search, or move to a local FHIR sandbox where indexing is synchronous.

entries.reason: LLM-as-judge scores vary run to run near the 0.7 threshold. A retry turns a statistical question into a single lucky pass.
entries.exit_plan: Score N runs and assert on the pass rate (statistical assertion), then remove the retry. Planned with the judge versioning work in Phase B.
